messages:
maria: Quick sync — landing copy sprint for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need final microcopy, lead routing, and webinar tie-in by EOD Friday. Thoughts?

ben: Timeline works for me. Can we prioritize Hosted CTA? That’s our highest traffic funnel.

elaine: Agree. Propose 3 CTA variants for Hosted: 
- "Get API key" 
- "Try Hosted API — 1,000 free tokens" 
- "Deploy hosted in minutes"
Also add a short line about predictable pricing.

sam: For Dedicated/Private we should gate with "Contact sales" + a compact form. Also offer a quick demo booking for mid-market (self-serve AE).

maria: For inbound routing, add a "deployment intent" radio (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) + company size + compliance checkbox. That will map to SF queues: hosted-selfserve, enterprise-dedicated, private-security.

ben: Can we add an estimated monthly tokens field? Even a rough band (0-10M / 10-100M / 100M+) helps scoring.

elaine: Also want short benchmark blurbs per page. Drafts: 
- Hosted: "p50 latency ~30–45ms for short prompts; automatic batching reduces per-token cost 3–5x."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput with reserved GPU pools; SLA-backed latency and uptime."
- Private: "VPC + KMS + on-prem options for regulated workloads; audit logs and fine-grained access controls."
(Keeping numbers as ranges for legal.)

sam: Noted — I’ll run these ranges past compliance/legal.

maria: Mock copy suggestions — please edit: 
- Hosted hero: "Redwood Hosted API — production-grade LLM inference with transparent pricing and instant API keys." CTA: "Get API key"
- Dedicated hero: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLAs." CTA: "Talk to sales"
- Private hero: "Private deployments with KMS, audit logs, and on-prem options." CTA: "Request a security brief"

ben: Two hero angle options for Hosted (A/B): 
1) "Latency-first inference for product teams" 
2) "Predictable, affordable LLM inference"
Which should be default?

elaine: Run both in a quick experiment. Default to option #2 for conversion-optimized messaging.

maria: Webinar tie-in: "Scaling inference — how we optimized costs with batching + caching". Run next Wed/Thu. Use webinar to capture Dedicated/Private intent via a question: "Are you evaluating Dedicated or Private deployments?" Route answers to AE queue.

sam: Routing rules proposal: 
- If deployment_intent != Hosted OR company_size > 500 => route to enterprise queue 
- If compliance_checkbox == true => add security-specialist tag 
- If estimated_tokens band >= 10-100M => priority lead

ben: UTMs & tagging: use utm_source=site, utm_campaign=site-refresh, and utm_content=hosted|dedicated|private. Ensure hidden fields in forms capture utm_campaign and utm_content.

maria: Quick draft of the form -> SF mapping (example):
```
form_field:deployment_intent => SF:Lead.Deployment_Intent__c
form_field:company_size => SF:Lead.Company_Size__c
form_field:estimated_tokens => SF:Lead.Est_E_Tokens_Band__c
form_field:compliance_checkbox => SF:Lead.Compliance_Flag__c
hidden:utm_campaign => SF:Lead.UTM_Campaign__c
```

oliver: Tiny nit: change "instant API key" to "instant API keys" (plural) in Hosted hero.

maria: Good catch, thanks.

maria: Owners & action items: 
1) Elaine — update copy draft by Thu noon (hosted + hero variants + benchmark blurbs)
2) Ben — set up A/B for Hosted hero and ensure analytics tagging (UTMs)
3) Sam — implement new form fields, SF mapping, and routing rules; QA by Friday
4) Maria — create webinar landing + benchmark appendix and share to comms

ben: I’ll also set up a short GA dashboard for hero variants so we can pick by conversion rate.

elaine: Will push a PR to the marketing site repo when copy is ready.

maria: If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. Otherwise I’ll follow up with GH tasks and a calendar invite for the copy review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Link to current marketing repo -> https://git.internal/repo/marketing-site (use this for PRs).
